detail.longDescription: “It's hard to describe [our reality] in words,” Margarita Lomberg, a microbiologist who has worked at Kholodny for more than three decades, says. “After a hard, sleepless night under shelling, we have to gather ourselves and work… How can we stay on the same level as other researchers if we are in much worse conditions?
